Relics._note: Sound added 2026-08-20 on the author's review ("relic might need a promo"). It goes on the TIER, not a rule: this tier is `class_condition: true`, and a class_condition tier bypasses the rules loop entirely, so a rule here would emit nothing. The .mp3 is the one curated under `basetype_sounds['Sanctified Relic']` — the only relic sound in the store. NOTE it now announces the whole live Relics class (the 7 SanctumRelic bases: Censer/Processional/Candlestick/Urn/Coffer/Tome/Papyrus), not just Sanctified Relics. That is deliberate: poewiki grades `Sanctified relic` as REMOVED FROM THE GAME, and FilterBlade names it zero times, so wiring the sound to that base alone would have wired it to something that cannot drop.
